```{r, file = here::here("snippets", "team_members.R")}
```

Team members are staff, students and long-term visitors (3 months or more) of the consortia.

## Current team members

```{r, results='asis'}
for (e in current_team) {
  member_name <- e[["name"]]

  if (!is.character(member_name) ||
      length(member_name) != 1 ||
      is.na(member_name) ||
      !nzchar(member_name)) {
    stop("Team member is missing a valid 'name' field.")
  }

  child_env <- list2env(list(
    name = member_name,
    affiliation = e[["affiliation"]] %||% "",
    webpage = e[["webpage"]] %||% "",
    github = e[["github"]] %||% "",
    twitter = e[["twitter"]] %||% "",
    bluesky = e[["bluesky"]] %||% "",
    orcid = e[["orcid"]] %||% "",
    description = trimws(e[["description"]] %||% "")
  ))

  cat(knitr::knit_child(
    "_team_member.Rmd",
    envir = child_env,
    quiet = TRUE
  ))
}
```

## Former team members

```{r, results='asis'}
former_team <- team[setdiff(names(team), names(current_team))] |>
  purrr::map_chr(function(e) {
    if (is.null(e[["webpage"]]) || e[["webpage"]] == "") {
      e[["name"]]
    } else {
      glue::glue('[{e[["name"]]}]({e[["webpage"]]})')
    }
  }) |>
  cat(sep = " · ")
```
